_README: Durable ledger of KNOWN-UNCOVERED changed Java lines that the diff-coverage gate would otherwise let slip out of sight. The gate is diff-scoped: it only ever examines lines a PR *changed*, so an uncovered line that lands once and is never re-touched becomes permanently unobservable to the gate. The measurable-changed-line FLOOR (see diff-coverage.sh) deliberately stops the gate FAILING on the coverage RATIO when a diff is tiny (a single uncovered helper in a 6-line diff should not fail a 70% gate) -- but a floor fixes brittleness, not invisibility. This ledger is the pair to the floor: below the floor the gate does not fail on the ratio, but every measurable-uncovered changed line must be either covered by a test OR recorded here, so nothing is silently dropped. Entries stay visible in every build's diff-coverage report until a test covers the line. RATCHET CONTRACT (mirrors test-fixtures/expectations/known-gaps.json): an entry whose line is NOW COVERED is STALE and FAILS the build -- you must delete it -- so lowering the failure rate never turns into a quietly-growing backlog. Keys beginning with '_' are metadata and ignored. Each entry: {file: FULL repo-relative path to the .java source (it MUST contain '.../src/main/java/...' and match the path as it appears in `git diff`, e.g. "mockserver/mockserver-core/src/main/java/org/mockserver/grpc/GrpcForwardTranslator.java" -- NOT the package-relative path below src/main/java), line: 1-based line number, symbol: human context, recorded: yyyy-mm-dd, reason: why it is uncovered / what test would close it}. A short or wrong path fails CLOSED (the line reports as both unverifiable and unrecorded) rather than silently excusing anything. To close an entry: add the test, confirm the line is covered, then remove the entry (leaving a stale entry fails CI).
_note_originally_cited_lines: The test-coverage audit (docs/plans/test-coverage-audit-2026-07.local.md) cited GrpcForwardTranslator:211-217 and GrpcProtoDescriptorStore:148 as uncovered changed lines that the gate flagged once (e20d6c218) and would never flag again. Those lines are NOW COVERED -- commit 903424d13 added GrpcFailSafeLoggingTest, whose decodeFallbackIsDiagnosableAtWarn drives GrpcForwardTranslator.decodeResponseFromUpstream into the fail-safe catch (executing the WARN LogEntry block) and, through store.getMockServerLogger(), covers GrpcProtoDescriptorStore.getMockServerLogger(). They are therefore NOT seeded here. This ledger is seeded empty; it exists as the durable mechanism for the next sub-floor miss.
